chunks: Abu 'Amr 'Uthman ibn Ahmad al-Daqqaq. By authorization.

key_terms.أَبُو: A teknonymic designation meaning 'father of,' used as part of a person's name.
key_terms.إِجَازَةٌ: Authorization to transmit, indicating a mode of scholarly transmission.
key_terms.الدَّقَّاقُ: A family name or nisbah, here identifying the individual as al-Daqqaq.
key_terms.عَمْرٍو: The named son in the teknonym Abū 'Amr.

ai.seo_question: Who is Abū 'Amr 'Uthmān ibn Aḥmad al-Daqqāq in Tahdhib al-Ahkam, and what does "ijazah" indicate?
ai.summary: This brief entry identifies Abū 'Amr 'Uthmān ibn Aḥmad al-Daqqāq and indicates transmission by ijazah. It is a biographical and transmission note rather than a hadith text with an isnad or substantive matn.
